- The plain image tool has no 4:5 shape. So I made a blank cream page first and then built the flyer on it with the image editor set to 4:5. On the free plan the flyer is 640px on its longest side.
- I asked for only your four pieces of text and no other words. The address goes over four lines, broken only after its commas.
- I couldn't view the finished image here, so I haven't checked the spelling myself. AI image models sometimes get small marks wrong, like the apostrophes, the en dashes (–) or "St.". Please check the address closely before you print. If anything is wrong, tell me and I'll make it again.
